title: Replace one coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $x:\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to\Omega$, let $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and let $\omega\in\Omega$. Replacing coordinate $i$ of $x$ by $\omega$ gives the vector whose value at $i$ is $\omega$ and whose other coordinates agree with $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a vector with entries in $\Omega$
